description:

File: crate-jmap-contacts-types/src/card.rs:155

Wire format byte-identical.

- Shape change + value-type change in contacts-types/src/card.rs (1-2 lines + import).
- Consumer code survey + migration as needed.
- PLAN.md §10 Sloppy-Value justification: this field stops being Sloppy-Value at the outer envelope; update.
- Cross-check: jscontact.rs hybrid typed module (recently expanded per JMAP-sehw scope) may have a parallel typed shape worth referencing in a doc-comment.

## Acceptance criteria

cargo test --workspace clean, lib clippy clean, wire format byte-identical, PLAN.md updated.
